english.title: Owner / driver of public hackney carriage permit plying for hire - no passenger no plate - outside London

(A)_[proprietor]_
(B)_[driver]_

of a public hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CARRIAGE AND INDEX NUMBER WHERE APPLICABLE..), permitted it to stand or ply for hire in
